description: Read the latest profiling report for a model on the AITune sidecar: measured latency, throughput and memory per backend, so you can choose how to serve it. Pass the model name as model. Read-only; it does not start a run. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

model.description: The model to read the profiling report for.

name: get_aitune_profiling
